SELECT p.system,regexp_replace(p.path, '\[[0-9]+\]', '[*]', 'g') path,p.param_key,p.discriminators,count(*) n FROM param_occurrence p WHERE p.project_id=:pid AND p.origin='network_config' AND p.param_key IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(p.is_identifier,false)
AND regexp_replace(p.path,'^.*/','') !~ '^(spare[0-9]*|dummy|reserved)$'
AND p.path NOT IN ('systemFrameNumber','mib/systemFrameNumber') GROUP BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT count(*) FROM param_occurrence p WHERE p.project_id=:pid AND p.param_key IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(p.is_identifier,false)
AND regexp_replace(p.path,'^.*/','') !~ '^(spare[0-9]*|dummy|reserved)$'
AND p.path NOT IN ('systemFrameNumber','mib/systemFrameNumber')

SELECT p.system,p.message,p.display_name,COALESCE(p.discriminators,'{}'::jsonb) discriminators,count(*) n FROM param_occurrence p WHERE p.project_id=:pid AND p.origin='network_config' AND p.param_key IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(p.is_identifier,false)
AND regexp_replace(p.path,'^.*/','') !~ '^(spare[0-9]*|dummy|reserved)$'
AND p.path NOT IN ('systemFrameNumber','mib/systemFrameNumber') AND p.display_name IN ('q-RxLevMin','timeToTrigger') GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
